description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Ability Boost, Triplecast Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind, Unlimited Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Abilities, Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Abilities; Ends after using 8 Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind abilities
TP Max: AOE Ice/NE, Lightning/NE, Water/NE or Wind/NE magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Ice, En-Lightning, En-Water or En-Wind

description.name: War-Awoken Embed Magic (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Ice//Lightning/Water/Wind/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least Lv.0/2 En-Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Stack to user
WS Gold: During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 3 & Damage +50% to Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Abilities to user
